shipping_delay_policy.title: Shipping Delay Policy
shipping_delay_policy.summary: When a Bookly order is delayed beyond an announced ETA and impacts a confirmed need-by date, customer outreach is required.
shipping_delay_policy.details: Agents should proactively notify the customer and offer recovery options such as expedited replacement or refund.

service_recovery_policy.title: Service Recovery Policy
service_recovery_policy.summary: For service-impacting delays, Bookly should strive to resolve the customer’s need with a free expedited replacement whenever possible.
service_recovery_policy.details: If the delay misses the customer’s time-sensitive need, agents may offer free expedited replacement or refund eligibility.

refund_policy.title: Refund Policy
refund_policy.summary: Refunds are eligible when a delay causes the order to miss the customer’s stated need-by date.
refund_policy.details: A financial refund requires explicit customer confirmation before execution.

escalation_policy.title: Escalation Policy
escalation_policy.summary: Customers may request human assistance at any time, and dissatisfaction should be escalated promptly.
escalation_policy.details: If the customer asks for a human or is dissatisfied, agents should create an escalation ticket and summarize the issue.

financial_action_confirmation_policy.title: Financial Action Confirmation Policy
financial_action_confirmation_policy.summary: No refund or credit action should be completed without explicit customer confirmation.
financial_action_confirmation_policy.details: The agent must ask the customer to confirm the exact refund amount and reason before issuing it.

shipping_upcharge_policy.title: Shipping Upcharge Policy
shipping_upcharge_policy.summary: Expedited shipping costs may be waived when the delay is caused by Bookly and the customer’s need-by date is missed.
shipping_upcharge_policy.details: If a customer asks whether they will have to pay extra for expedited shipping because an order is delayed, the agent may waive the expedited shipping upcharge to preserve customer satisfaction.

replacement_upcharge_policy.title: Replacement Item Upcharge Policy
replacement_upcharge_policy.summary: Bookly may waive the cost difference for a replacement item that is more expensive than the original purchase in delay recovery situations.
replacement_upcharge_policy.details: When a replacement item is needed to meet the customer’s need-by date and the chosen alternative is more expensive, the agent may absorb the upcharge rather than passing the difference to the customer.

discretionary_compensation_policy.title: Discretionary Compensation Policy
discretionary_compensation_policy.summary: Agents may offer discretionary discounts, future store credit, or promotional value to smooth poor customer experiences.
discretionary_compensation_policy.details: For delay-impacted orders and service recovery conversations, agents can offer a one-time promotional credit or discount to retain goodwill, especially when the customer is upset or the delay is due to Bookly’s service failure.
